boundaries.name: poseidon-permutation
boundaries.obligation: The plonky2 Poseidon permutation is an opaque length-preserving callback; collision resistance, indifferentiability and the sponge security argument are premises, not results.

boundaries.name: goldilocks-field-encoding
boundaries.obligation: The mapping of bytes and limbs into plonky2 Goldilocks elements (from_canonical_u32/u64, to_canonical_u64) is assumed canonical and injective on the stated ranges.

boundaries.name: rust-semantics
boundaries.obligation: The Lean model is handwritten; nothing proves it refines the Rust source, rustc lowering, integer wrapping, or panic behaviour.

boundaries.name: salt-and-rng-freshness
boundaries.obligation: Freshness and unpredictability of the caller-supplied 40-byte salt and of the trapdoor sampler's RNG are the caller's obligation; nothing here constrains them.
